items.title: 2. Number of Turns of the Coil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 2. Number of Turns of the Coil: a main subheading of 10.8 Factors affecting emf, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 243-243.

blocks.text: Faraday ke law ke mutabiq induced emf coil ke turns ki number ke bhi proportional hai: turns dogune to emf dogni. Zyada turns, zyada induced emf.
